name: turtle
provenance: Adversarial fixture A3 'Turtle' (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §14 A3): one fungible normal domain, budget 4, two Trials rewarding 5 and 3, every positive amount a legal entry, optional allocation, winner-take-all with shared-full ties, no tiebreak before shared. The source states the exact oracles: 15 legal allocations including residue, (4,0) has zero strict dominators, and C1 fails because (4,0) never loses — an uncounterable pure strategy exists. Config lives in configs/toy/turtle_5_3.json; the player budget and oracles are committed here, transcribed from the source rather than reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).

expected.notes: (4,0) has zero strict dominators (no single strategy improves on it in every column) and, more to the point, it never loses: no strategy beats it head-to-head through Recognition Points. C1 fails because an uncounterable pure strategy exists — (4,0) never loses, so no deck of winner-take-all counters can dislodge it. 'Strict dominator' (better in every column) and 'head-to-head counter' (win[a,b]=1) are distinct relations; A3 has zero of the former for (4,0) and, crucially, zero of the latter against (4,0).
